meta.title: Earnings Press Release FY2025
meta.source_note: Unaudited Press Release distributed to media and exchanges

passages.text: Meridian Textiles Ltd delivers robust operational momentum for FY2025: Total revenue grew 18% to reach INR 1,180 crore, demonstrating solid market share gains and expanded export dispatches across North America and Europe.

Managing Director commented: 'Our strong revenue of INR 1,180 crore showcases the resilience of our integrated manufacturing ecosystem, driven by premium technical textiles and solid order visibility.'
